title_en: LOWE'S Profesyonel Collagen Hydro Bomb Mask 50 ml
ingredients_inci: Aqua, Bis-Ethylhexyloxyphenol Methoxyphenyl Triazine, Cetearyl Alcohol, Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate, Propylene Glycol, C12-15 Alkyl Benzoate, Dimethicone, Phenylbenzimidazole Sulfonic Acid, Ceteareth-25, Glyceryl Stearate, Oxothiazolidine, Peg-12 Dimethicone, Theobroma Cacao Seed Extract, Butyrospermum Parkii Butter, Zinc Oxide, Niacinamide, sopropyl Myristate, Glycerin, Phenoxyethanol, Parfum, Alpha-Arbutin, Glutathione, Allantoin, Hyaluronic Acid, Centella Asiatica Extract, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Extract, Lavandula Angustifolia Flower Extract, Melaleuca Alternifolia Leaf Extract, Ethylhexylglycerin, Benzyl Salicylate, Hexyl Cinnamal, Terpineol.
directions: Apply a thin layer of the mask to your clean and dry skin, avoiding the eye and mouth areas. Once the mask is completely dry, peel it off fraom your skin.
purpose_from_pack: It helps maintain the skin's moisture balance, promoting a firmer, smoother, and more radiant appearance. Collagen and Hyaluronic Acid provide deep hydration and enhance elasticity, while Glutathione protects against free radicals, supporting a more vibrant look. Aloe Vera, Chamomile, Green Tea, and Cucumber Extracts refresh the skin. Lactic Acid contributes to skin renewal with its gentle peeling effect.
warnings: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. In case of contact, rinse thoroughly with plenty of water. Store in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight, in its closed packaging, and out of reach of children.
label_company_on_pack: CEELLO KOZMETİK VE KİMYA SANAYİ TİCARET A.Ş. (Afyonkarahisar)
regulatory_flags: AHA: pH ≥ 3.5 للتجزئة وتحذيرات ملصق إلزامية (9.6)
